new_libraries.name: ILI9341_GFX
new_libraries.author: JKBusse
new_libraries.sentence: Fast ILI9341 SPI display driver for the ESP32, compatible with Adafruit_GFX.
new_libraries.paragraph: Register-level DMA driver with hardware D/C switching via SPI dual output, a framebuffer with dirty-region updates, tear-free VSync, hardware scrolling, readback and screenshots. The fast path needs a classic ESP32; other boards use plain SPI.
